body:
# News and society

Family dinners turn to the news sooner or later: prices, jobs, elections, housing. These words let you follow a news segment and give an opinion without switching to English. Many are formal, but they are used in ordinary conversation about current events.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 政府 | zhèngfǔ | government |
| 政策 | zhèngcè | policy (government or company) |
| 政治 | zhèngzhì | politics |
| 经济 | jīngjì | the economy |
| 选举 | xuǎnjǔ | election |
| 投票 | tóupiào | to vote / cast a ballot |
| 法律 | fǎlǜ | law (the legal system) |
| 抗议 | kàngyì | to protest |
| 物价 | wùjià | prices (of goods in general) / cost of living |
| 失业 | shīyè | to be unemployed / lose one's job |
| 移民 | yímín | to immigrate / immigrant |
| 环境污染 | huánjìng wūrǎn | environmental pollution |
| 气候变化 | qìhòu biànhuà | climate change |
| 社会 | shèhuì | society |
| 新闻 | xīnwén | the news |
| 报道 | bàodào | to report (in the news) / news report |
| 媒体 | méitǐ | the media |
| 舆论 | yúlùn | public opinion |
| 腐败 | fǔbài | corruption |
| 改革 | gǎigé | reform |
| 发展 | fāzhǎn | development / to develop (a city, economy) |
| 贫富差距 | pínfù chājù | wealth gap / gap between rich and poor |
| 老龄化 | lǎolínghuà | population aging |
| 争议 | zhēngyì | controversy / dispute |
| 战争 | zhànzhēng | war |
| 关注 | guānzhù | to follow closely / keep an eye on (news, an issue) |
| 房价 | fángjià | housing prices |

## Which word?

- **政策 vs 政治**: 政策 is a specific policy (新政策). 政治 is politics as a whole (不聊政治).
- **选举 vs 投票**: 选举 is the election as an event. 投票 is what you do on the day (去投票).
- **新闻 vs 消息**: 新闻 is news coverage. 消息 is a piece of information or a message (有消息吗?).
- **报道 vs 报告**: 报道 is what journalists do. 报告 is a formal report to a boss or an official body.
- **舆论 vs 媒体**: 媒体 are the outlets. 舆论 is public opinion, the pressure that builds up because of them.
- **腐败 vs 贪污**: 腐败 is corruption in general. 贪污 is specifically embezzling public money.
- **关注 vs 注意**: 关注 means you follow an issue over time. 注意 means notice or watch out.

## Examples

- 这个政策对小企业影响很大。 zhège zhèngcè duì xiǎo qǐyè yǐngxiǎng hěn dà: This policy hits small businesses hard
- 今年经济不太好，工作很难找。 jīnnián jīngjì bú tài hǎo, gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo: The economy's bad this year and jobs are hard to find
- 大家都在关注这次选举。 dàjiā dōu zài guānzhù zhè cì xuǎnjǔ: Everyone is following this election
- 这两年物价涨得太厉害了。 zhè liǎng nián wùjià zhǎng de tài lìhai le: Prices have shot up these past two years
- 他失业半年了，还在找工作。 tā shīyè bàn nián le, hái zài zhǎo gōngzuò: He's been out of work for six months and is still looking
- 很多媒体都报道了这件事。 hěn duō méitǐ dōu bàodào le zhè jiàn shì: Lots of outlets reported on this
- 舆论压力太大，公司只好道歉。 yúlùn yālì tài dà, gōngsī zhǐhǎo dàoqiàn: Under heavy public pressure, the company had to apologize
- 贫富差距越来越大。 pínfù chājù yuè lái yuè dà: The gap between rich and poor keeps growing
- 人口老龄化是个大问题。 rénkǒu lǎolínghuà shì gè dà wèntí: The aging population is a big problem
- 我一直在关注这件事。 wǒ yìzhí zài guānzhù zhè jiàn shì: I've been following this closely

cards.Example: 政府最近出台了新的补贴。 zhèngfǔ zuìjìn chūtái le xīn de bǔtiē: The government just rolled out new subsidies
cards.Notes: 出台 = to roll out (a policy)

cards.Example: 这个政策对小企业影响很大。 zhège zhèngcè duì xiǎo qǐyè yǐngxiǎng hěn dà: This policy hits small businesses hard
cards.Notes: 政策 = policy; 政治 = politics

cards.Example: 我们家吃饭的时候不聊政治。 wǒmen jiā chīfàn de shíhou bù liáo zhèngzhì: We don't talk politics at the dinner table
cards.Notes: 政治敏感 = politically sensitive

cards.Example: 今年经济不太好，工作很难找。 jīnnián jīngjì bú tài hǎo, gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo: The economy's bad this year and jobs are hard to find
cards.Notes: Also 'economical' in some phrases: 经济舱 = economy class

cards.Example: 大家都在关注这次选举。 dàjiā dōu zài guānzhù zhè cì xuǎnjǔ: Everyone is following this election
cards.Notes: 选举 = the election as an event; 投票 = the act of voting

cards.Example: 你昨天去投票了吗？ nǐ zuótiān qù tóupiào le ma: Did you go vote yesterday?
cards.Notes: 投……一票 = vote for someone

cards.Example: 这在法律上是不允许的。 zhè zài fǎlǜ shang shì bù yǔnxǔ de: That's not allowed by law
cards.Notes: 法律 = law in general; 违法 = illegal; 律师 = lawyer

cards.Example: 很多人上街抗议新政策。 hěn duō rén shàngjiē kàngyì xīn zhèngcè: Lots of people took to the streets to protest the new policy
cards.Notes: 上街 = take to the streets; 示威 = demonstrate (more formal)

cards.English: prices (of goods in general) / cost of living
cards.Example: 这两年物价涨得太厉害了。 zhè liǎng nián wùjià zhǎng de tài lìhai le: Prices have shot up these past two years
cards.Notes: 物价 = the general price level; 价格 = the price of one item; 通胀 = inflation

cards.English: to be unemployed / lose one's job
cards.Example: 他失业半年了，还在找工作。 tā shīyè bàn nián le, hái zài zhǎo gōngzuò: He's been out of work for six months and is still looking
cards.Notes: 失业率 = unemployment rate; 被裁员 = laid off; 辞职 = quit

cards.Example: 他们一家十年前移民到了加拿大。 tāmen yìjiā shí nián qián yímín dào le Jiānádà: Their family immigrated to Canada ten years ago
cards.Notes: Both verb and noun; 新移民 = recent immigrants

cards.Example: 这个城市的环境污染很严重。 zhège chéngshì de huánjìng wūrǎn hěn yánzhòng: Pollution in this city is serious
cards.Notes: 空气污染 = air pollution; 雾霾 = smog

cards.Example: 气候变化让夏天越来越热。 qìhòu biànhuà ràng xiàtiān yuè lái yuè rè: Climate change is making summers hotter and hotter
cards.Notes: 全球变暖 = global warming

cards.Example: 现在社会节奏太快了。 xiànzài shèhuì jiézòu tài kuài le: Society moves too fast these days
cards.Notes: 社会问题 = social issue

cards.Example: 你看今天的新闻了吗？ nǐ kàn jīntiān de xīnwén le ma: Did you see today's news?
cards.Notes: 新闻 = news reports; 消息 = a piece of information or a message

cards.English: to report (in the news) / news report
cards.Example: 很多媒体都报道了这件事。 hěn duō méitǐ dōu bàodào le zhè jiàn shì: Lots of outlets reported on this
cards.Notes: 报道 = journalism; 报告 = a formal report to a boss or an official body

cards.Example: 社交媒体上什么说法都有。 shèjiāo méitǐ shang shénme shuōfǎ dōu yǒu: On social media you hear every version of the story
cards.Notes: 社交媒体 = social media; 自媒体 = independent creators

cards.Example: 舆论压力太大，公司只好道歉。 yúlùn yālì tài dà, gōngsī zhǐhǎo dàoqiàn: Under heavy public pressure, the company had to apologize
cards.Notes: Formal; 网上的舆论 = online opinion

cards.Example: 那个官员因为腐败被抓了。 nàge guānyuán yīnwèi fǔbài bèi zhuā le: That official was arrested for corruption
cards.Notes: 腐败 = corruption in general; 贪污 = embezzle; 反腐 = anti-corruption

cards.Example: 教育改革一直都有争议。 jiàoyù gǎigé yìzhí dōu yǒu zhēngyì: Education reform has always been controversial
cards.Notes: 改革开放 = China's 'reform and opening up'

cards.Example: 这几年这个城市发展得很快。 zhè jǐ nián zhège chéngshì fāzhǎn de hěn kuài: This city has developed fast in the last few years
cards.Notes: 发展中国家 = developing country

cards.English: wealth gap / gap between rich and poor
cards.Example: 贫富差距越来越大。 pínfù chājù yuè lái yuè dà: The gap between rich and poor keeps growing
cards.Notes: 差距 = gap: 拉大差距 = widen the gap

cards.Example: 人口老龄化是个大问题。 rénkǒu lǎolínghuà shì gè dà wèntí: The aging population is a big problem
cards.Notes: 老龄化社会 = aging society; 养老 = elder care / retirement

cards.Example: 这个决定引起了很大的争议。 zhège juédìng yǐnqǐ le hěn dà de zhēngyì: The decision caused a lot of controversy
cards.Notes: 有争议 = controversial; 争论 = to argue a point

cards.Example: 战争让很多人失去了家园。 zhànzhēng ràng hěn duō rén shīqù le jiāyuán: The war cost many people their homes
cards.Notes: 打仗 = fight a war (spoken)

cards.English: to follow closely / keep an eye on (news, an issue)
cards.Example: 我一直在关注这件事。 wǒ yìzhí zài guānzhù zhè jiàn shì: I've been following this closely
cards.Notes: 关注 = follow with interest (also on social media); 注意 = notice or be careful

cards.Example: 房价太高，年轻人买不起房。 fángjià tài gāo, niánqīngrén mǎi bu qǐ fáng: Housing is so expensive young people can't afford to buy
cards.Notes: 房价涨/跌 = prices rise/fall

cards.English: What do you think about this?
cards.Pinyin: nǐ zěnme kàn zhè jiàn shì
cards.Notes: 怎么看 = what's your view; more natural than 你的意见是什么

cards.English: It's hard to say who's right and who's wrong.
cards.Pinyin: hěn nán shuō shéi duì shéi cuò
cards.Notes: A neutral way to stay out of an argument

cards.English: I saw it on the news.
cards.Pinyin: wǒ zài xīnwén shang kàndào de
cards.Notes: The 是……的 pattern (with 是 dropped) stresses where you saw it
